reviews.reason: The inbox fences exposed state synchronously by current scope, then installs an external notification subscription and resets pagination, connection and write state when auth/client/scope changes. Subscription events and session replacement originate outside a user click; cleanup closes the prior subscription. The inbox fixture retains reconnect refetch, unmount cleanup and immediate workspace selection fencing. Reassessed 2026-11-17: The changed inbox witness adds the Antd App fixture provider and updates separate settings save labels. Inbox subscription cleanup, workspace scope fencing, failed-fetch snapshot retention and rejected mutation assertions remain unchanged. Reassessed: Activation delays background subscription, but the scope reset and external event delivery stay independent of whether the drawer is open.

Each actor/workspace subscription scope owns its stored messages, connection status and pending write. Scope changes can arrive without any inbox event and must reset that data together before allowing the next subscription.
